responsibility: Implements the simplified warning/error/fatal reporting used by GCC host generator programs rather than the full compiler diagnostic engine. It owns the generator-side progname and have_error state, prints plain stderr messages with fixed prefixes, provides a simpler trim_filename helper, and implements fancy_abort in terms of an immediate internal_error exit.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the lightweight generator-side errors pair: it defines the simple stderr-printing warning/error/fatal/internal_error routines, progname/have_error state, trim_filename, and fancy_abort, whereas errors.h only declares this minimal API.
